k-gtavi.title: GTA VI release countdown coins
k-gtavi.sourceSays: Posts say the GTA VI release is two days away and present $GTAVI-named coins as a way to trade the countdown; one account calls a $GTAVI contract bundled and warns against it.
k-gtavi.reason: Nov 17 posts cite the public GTA VI release countdown as the theme behind the coins; pools are under 2h old, opened after the story. Many same-name copies, one flagged as bundled.

k-sym-DACITYCOIN.title: Move to Dacity GTA 6 billboard coins
k-sym-DACITYCOIN.sourceSays: Posts say Miami ads read "Move to $Dacity" ahead of the GTA 6 launch and that a GTA 6 trailer showed an AudaCity logo; traders dispute which of $DACITY and $DACITYCOIN is the real ticker.
k-sym-DACITYCOIN.reason: Posts from Oct 24 to Nov 17 describe the billboard and trailer-logo meme with an origin; the ticker rivalry is contested and the two newest pools are copies.

k-lucia.reason: Posts are call-group multiples, VIP DM pitches and scam alerts about bundled supply for JALU and LUCIA; no story beyond the GTA VI fan-character name.
